entityRules.notes: The ZIP export contains the query definition only; site rows still come from plants backfill until dev_ignition rows are supplied.

entityRules.condition: Ordre_Cellule is present or Equipement looks like a Cellule label.
Nom_Onduleur or Num_Onduleur is present, or Equipement contains Onduleur.

namedQueries.purpose: Canonical architecture/tag generation query used by Perspective session custom.Architecture and Create_tag_V3.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Site, type_poste, Agregateur, Equipement, NULL AS Ordre_Cellule, NULL AS Nom_Onduleur, NULL AS Num_Onduleur, NULL AS Adresse_Ip, Client, Hyperviseur FROM dev_ignition.Sites INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Clients ON id_Client=idClient INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON id_Sites = idSite INNER JOIN dev_ignition.type_postes ON idtype_poste = id_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lienSites_postes_equipements ON id_Site_poste = idlien_Sites_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Equipements ON idEquipements = id_equipement UNION ALL SELECT Site, type_poste, Agregateur, Cellule AS Equipement, ordre_cellule AS Ordre_Cellule, NULL AS Nom_Onduleur, NULL AS Num_Onduleur, NULL AS Adresse_Ip, Client, Hyperviseur FROM dev_ignition.Sites INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Clients ON id_Client=idClient INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON id_Sites = idSite INNER JOIN dev_ignition.type_postes ON idtype_poste = id_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_sites_typepostes_cellules ON id_lien_sites_typepostes = idlien_Sites_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Cellules ON idCellules = id_cellule UNION ALL SELECT Site, type_poste, Agregateur, 'Onduleur' AS Equipement, NULL AS Equipement, Onduleur AS Nom_Onduleur, numero_onduleur AS Num_Onduleur, Adresse_ip AS Adresse_Ip, Client, Hyperviseur FROM dev_ignition.Sites INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Clients ON id_Client=idClient INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON id_Sites = idSite INNER JOIN dev_ignition.type_postes ON idtype_poste = id_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lienSites_postes_onduleurs ON id_Site_poste = idlien_Sites_type_postes INNER JOIN dev_ignition.Onduleurs ON idOnduleurs = id_onduleurs ORDER BY Site, type_poste;

SELECT type_poste FROM dev_ignition.Sites INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON id_Sites = idSite INNER JOIN dev_ignition.type_postes ON idtype_poste = id_type_postes WHERE Site = :id_Site

namedQueries.purpose: Lists cellules and order for one site/poste link.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Cellule, ordre_cellule FROM dev_ignition.Cellules INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_sites_typepostes_cellules ON id_cellule = idCellules INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON idlien_Sites_type_postes = id_lien_sites_typepostes WHERE id_lien_sites_typepostes = :ID_LIEN_SITE_POSTE

namedQueries.purpose: Lists equipment for one site/poste link.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Equipement FROM dev_ignition.Equipements INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lienSites_postes_equipements ON id_equipement = idEquipements INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON idlien_Sites_type_postes = id_Site_poste WHERE id_Site_poste = :ID_LIEN_SITE_POSTE

namedQueries.purpose: Lists inverter type/name and number for one site/poste link.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Onduleur, numero_onduleur FROM dev_ignition.Onduleurs INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lienSites_postes_onduleurs ON id_onduleurs = idOnduleurs INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON idlien_Sites_type_postes = id_Site_poste WHERE id_Site_poste = :ID_LIEN_SITE_POSTE

namedQueries.purpose: Lists inverter IP addresses for one site/poste link.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Adresse_ip FROM dev_ignition.Onduleurs INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lienSites_postes_onduleurs ON id_onduleurs = idOnduleurs INNER JOIN dev_ignition.lien_Sites_type_postes ON idlien_Sites_type_postes = id_Site_poste WHERE id_Site_poste = :ID_LIEN_SITE_POSTE

namedQueries.purpose: Maps site coordinates and hypervisor flag.
namedQueries.sql: SELECT Site, Lattitude, Longitude, Hyperviseur FROM dev_ignition.Sites

perspectiveTransforms.summary: Builds archi[Site][type_poste] with CELLULES and ONDULEURS arrays, appending equipements from Create_Tag rows.
Creates Ignition tags under [default]/Site/type_poste folders for equipements, cellules and onduleurs.

notes: This file is metadata extracted from the Ignition project export, not a dump from dev_ignition.
Do not connect to BDD_Ignition in this lot.
The third UNION branch in Create_Tag has a duplicate alias around Equipement in the export; importer classification uses Nom_Onduleur and Num_Onduleur to avoid relying on that ambiguous alias.
